articles.title: Bitcoin stalls as open interest decline raises questions about rally's staying power
articles.snippet: BTC retreated from a two-week high of $64,500 as falling open interest and weak spot demand cast doubt on the sustainability of July's 8.4% advance.

articles.title: Securitize eyes acquisitions with $400 million war chest after going public, CEO says
articles.snippet: Following its NYSE debut, Securitize CEO Carlos Domingo said the firm wants to expand its institutional tokenization platform rather than buy competitors.

articles.title: Nigel Farage to resign from UK Parliament amid crypto “gift” scandal, will stand in by-election
articles.snippet: The Reform party leader and Brexit champion confirmed that he was the subject of probes by UK authorities following reports of what he called “gifts” from figures tied to cry pto ventures.

articles.title: Vitalik Buterin confirms AI identified his anonymous Ethereum proposal contribution
articles.snippet: The Ethereum co-founder said AI recognized his intellectual habits, ending a two-week public challenge to identify an anonymous contribution he made.

articles.title: Yield Guild Games cuts 35 staff, shuts game publisher to focus on AI
articles.snippet: Yield Guild Games said tough crypto and video game market conditions mean its YGG Play business is no longer commercially sustainable.
